title: (fix) O3-5988: Use the backend attachment upload limit
body:
## Requirements

- [x] This PR has a title that briefly describes the work done including the ticket number. If there is a ticket, make sure your PR title includes a [conventional commit](https://o3-docs.openmrs.org/en-US/docs/frontend-modules/contributing/#contributing-guidelines) label. See existing PR titles for inspiration.
- [ ] My work is based on designs, which are linked or shown either in the Jira ticket or the description below. (See also: [Styleguide](http://om.rs/o3ui))
- [x] My work includes tests or is validated by existing tests.

## Summary

The attachment uploader uses a frontend size limit that can differ from what the backend accepts. For example, the default 1 MB frontend limit rejects a 3 MB image even when the backend permits 5 MB.

Read `attachments.maxUploadFileSize` for both the displayed limit and file validation. If the setting cannot be loaded or is invalid, keep file selection disabled and offer Retry. The old frontend `maxFileSize` setting is marked deprecated and no longer used.

https://openmrs.atlassian.net/browse/O3-5988

## Other

The backend remains responsible for upload validation. A reverse proxy may impose a lower request-size limit; this change does not alter that configuration.
